 By the numbers: Al-Ahli aims to confirm dominance over Al-Gharafa
 Monday 26-10-2026 
 محمد أبو ريان 
 Al-Ahli host Al-Gharafa today, Monday, at the Al-Inma Stadium in Jeddah, in the third round of the AFC Champions League, relying on a positive record in their recent encounters against their opponent.
 Al-Ahli, the defending champions of the tournament for the last two editions, have maintained their unbeaten record in their last six matches against Al-Gharafa, achieving three victories and three draws, after losing the first two encounters between them. They have also scored in seven out of eight matches.
 Al-Ahli need to improve their defensive solidity after conceding goals in their last two matches, including a late equaliser against Pakhtakor in their continental campaign opener.
 In contrast, Al-Gharafa enter the match searching for a win to enhance their chances in the competition, but they face a tough challenge after losing their last four matches in the AFC Champions League, including encounters from last season.
 During their recent losing streak, the Qatari team has scored only two goals while conceding 13, putting them up against a tough test in their match against Al-Ahli, who are seeking to continue their superiority.

 Al Ahly's management is negotiating with Albanian Igli Tare, former sporting director of AC Milan, to grant him extensive powers in managing the sporting strategy and transfers. 
 3 absences hit Al Ahly FC against Al-Gharafa in AFC Champions League Elite
 A blow for Al Ahly FC ahead of their match against Qatari Al-Gharafa on Monday with the absence of three players: Merih Demiral, Saleh Abu Al-Shamat, and Naif Masoud due to incomplete fitness. 
 Toney and Trincão feature in the Saudi Pro League Team of the Week for Round 11

 Announcement of match dates for round 13 of Saudi Pro League
 The Saudi Pro League Association has set the dates for the thirteenth round of the Saudi Pro League to take place from November 5 to 7. 
 Yacine Brahimi: Al Ahly FC are a strong team but Al-Gharafa are aiming for victory
 Yacine Brahimi, Al-Gharafa player, confirmed the difficulty of facing Al Ahly FC, the holder of the last two titles, emphasizing his team's desire to win in Jeddah. 
 Saudi Pro League representatives face tough Asian tests in the elite
 Al-Hilal face Al-Shamal, Al Ahly FC take on Al-Gharafa, Al-Qadsiah meet Al-Sadd, and Al-Ittihad play Pakhtakor in the Asian round, while the match between Al-Nassr and Al-Wasl has been postponed. 
 Al-Gharafa coach: Al Ahly clash is like Al-Hilal.. we aim for victory
 Martínez, Al-Gharafa's coach, confirmed that the match against Al Ahly tomorrow in the AFC Champions League will be strong and balanced, and his team will fight to earn the three points. 
 Al Ahly FC face Al-Gharafa test as Bousic warns of tough match
 Bousic, Al Ahly FC's coach, confirmed the difficulty of facing Qatari side Al-Gharafa tomorrow in the AFC Champions League Elite despite playing at home in front of their fans.
